response.query: What concrete pilot success criteria and decision rules (e.g., retention at 3 months, instrument reliability thresholds, recruitment pace) will determine go/no-go for baseline scale-up?
response.answer: Pilot success criteria include 3-month retention rates, instrument reliability above 0.8, and recruitment within 60 days. Go/no-go decision hinges on meeting all criteria.
